text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A after large gains, but those sales did not prevent later account losses; I should not mistake realizing gains for protecting my portfolio.","After buying all five stocks in Period 6, I made no trades as the account fell sharply; I should review my overall exposure and risk plan rather than react to losses or ignore risk altogether.","Because prices move randomly, I should base future trades on a consistent portfolio plan—not on recent performance or the discomfort of seeing losses."]}
